fields.acceptance: A testscript with a fake rex sets rhiza.autonomy.plan=auto and queues a milestone request and a feature request: the daemon's plan run start of the milestone request has --milestone and no --autonomous, its journal's started entry is not autonomous, and the feature request's run start carries --autonomous
fields.statement: The daemon starts the plan run of a milestone request without --autonomous even when rhiza.autonomy.plan is auto, so it waits on the owner's interview; feature and bug requests keep following rhiza.autonomy.plan

fields.acceptance: Testscripts: run start --workflow plan --new <intent> --milestone --autonomous, and run start --workflow plan --autonomous on a record change set, each exit with a usage error naming the rule and write no journal and no draft; the same starts without --autonomous run, and run start --workflow plan --new <intent> --autonomous (an intention) still runs autonomous; run resume of a plan run on a record change set whose started entry is autonomous exits with the same usage error
fields.statement: rhiza run start refuses --autonomous on a plan run that plans a milestone (with --milestone, for a request of kind milestone, or on an existing record change set) with a usage error naming the rule that milestone planning needs the owner, and run resume refuses to continue such a run journaled autonomous, so no milestone plan run's agent gets RHIZA_AUTONOMOUS=1
